messages:
ashley: quick sync — we identified 3 nodes in rack g2 with recurring Xid 31 / ECC deltas over the last week. want to run a focused rotation + soak before we put them back in service.

sam: good call. are these the ones that passed quick burnin but flaked under longer runs?

ashley: exactly. short stress runs looked fine, but 12–24h soak shows memory ECC counters drift and occasional Xid spikes around heavy batching.

jia: can we repro in the lab with thermal cycling? last time temperature change exposed a marginal solder joint.

miguel: +1 on thermal cycle. also suggest swapping PCIe slot and running driver-pinned kernel (470 -> 510) to rule out driver regressions.

ashley: proposed plan: 1) cordon + drain nodes from prod (no immediate replacement until we validate). 2) run 72h soak in lab with logging + ECC counters scraped every 30s. 3) if fail, reseat and repeat. 4) if still fail, RMA.

ryan: sounds reasonable. what are the acceptance criteria for 'pass'?

ashley: pass = no Xid > 0 events and ECC corrected/unreported counters stable for 72h under representative batch profile (we'll run continuous perfbench with dynamic batch sizes). will also check SMM logs and nvml traces.

sam: timeline? we have a small customer spike tomorrow, prefer to start after the midnight window.

ashley: starting drain tonight 02:00 UTC, bench reservation from 03:00–06:00 to stage nodes into lab, soak starts 06:30 UTC. expected finish 72h later.

oncall-bot: NOTE: drain job queued — k8s drain for node gpu-g2-3a scheduled at 1778890800.

jia: adding a repro harness snippet to the bench run — runs 2 parallel streams of perfbench, each with random sequence lengths, heavy KV cache pressure. also toggles quantization paths.

ashley: here's the drain + soak job bits to use (copy/paste):

```
# drain (one node)
kubectl cordon gpu-g2-3a
kubectl drain gpu-g2-3a --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=300

# soak job (k8s CronJob-ish for bench)
apiVersion: batch/v1
kind: Job
metadata:
  name: gpu-soak-run-3a
spec:
  template:
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: perfbench
        image: redwood/soak-perfbench:stable
        args: ["--duration","72h","--streams","2","--seq-dist","uniform","--kv-pressure","high"]
        resources:
          limits:
            nvidia.com/gpu: 1
      restartPolicy: Never
```

sam: thanks. can we also enable the debug-level NVML export and push to the ephemeral s3 bucket? add syslog forwarding and increase monitoring retention for these nodes.

ashley: done — infra ticket INF-6523 updated with presigned upload and Loki label `soak=g2-3a`.

miguel: if we get intermittent ECC corrected counts, do we have a threshold for automatic RMA? last run we let one through and it came back.

ryan: propose threshold: any Xid > 0 incident OR ECC corrected spikes > 100k within 24h => fail. minor corrected increments (single-digit) are fine. we can tune after this sweep.

jia: I'll run PCIe slot-swaps and a single-driver rollback test in parallel to separate HW/driver. will attach diff logs to INF-6523.

ashley: tagging @miguel and @jia for lab tasks, @ryan to review RMA threshold, @sam for scheduling windows. ping me if you see anything weird. i'll post short summary in ops channel when soak completes. :thumbsup:

sam: ack. will monitor cluster capacity and shift traffic if needed. good checklist to follow.

oncall-bot: REMINDER: bench reservation expires in 80 hours unless extended.

ashley: noted — will reopen reservation if we need longer soak after initial 72h. thanks team.
